xna-type.name: GamerPrivilegeSetting
xna-type.summary: Describes the conditions in which a privilege is available.

member.name: Blocked
member.summary: This privilege is not available for the current gamer profile.

member.name: Everyone
member.summary: This privilege is available for the current gamer profile.

member.name: FriendsOnly
member.summary: This privilege is only available for friends of the current gamer profile. Use the IsFriend method to check which gamers are friends.
